basics.dressSub: Think garden party, Swedish Midsommar, not black tie
details.acc.p1: We've held a block of rooms at The Wheatsheaf Inn, a 10-minute drive away, under "Alex & Jordan."
details.acc.p2: Camping on-site is also available — let us know if you'd like a pitch.
details.dress.p1: Country formal. Think floaty dresses, linen suits and comfortable shoes — the reception spills onto grass in the evening.
details.dress.p2: Bring a layer; barn evenings can turn cool.
details.gifts.p: Your presence is truly the present. If you'd like to give something, we've set up a honeymoon fund — details on the RSVP form.
details.intro: A few more details to help you plan your day with us — more will follow closer to the date.
details.kids.p1: We love your little ones, but our day is adults-only, with the exception of immediate family.
details.kids.p2: Plus-ones are noted on your invitation — just let us know who's joining.
faq.1.a: Please arrive from 3:30pm and be seated by 3:50pm — the ceremony begins promptly at 4:00pm.
faq.2.a: Yes — the barn and orchard are step-free, with accessible parking near the entrance. Let us know if you need anything specific.
faq.3.a: If a plus-one has been included, it will say so on your invitation and on the RSVP form.
faq.4.a: There's a space for this on the RSVP form — just let us know and we'll make sure the kitchen is aware.
faq.5.a: Yes, free parking is available in the north field, a short walk from the barn.
faq.6.a: If it rains, the ceremony moves into the barn — either way, we'll be married by 4:30pm.
faq.7.a: We'd love for you to be present rather than behind a screen — we'll have a photographer, and phones can come out from the reception onward.
faq.7.q: Can I take photos during the ceremony?
faq.8.a: Please reply by 1 April 2027 using the form below so we can finalise catering and seating.

prog.1.p: Please be seated in the orchard by 3:50pm.
prog.2.p: Under the old oak in the orchard, weather permitting.
prog.3.p: Fizz on the lawn while we take photographs.
prog.4.p: Music, dancing and a late-night snack.
prog.5.p: Taxis booked for 11:30pm and midnight — ask us if you need one arranged.
rsvp.h: Let us know if you can make it
rsvp.p: We can't wait to celebrate with you. Please reply by the date below so we can finalise catering and seating.
travel.car.p2: Free on-site parking is available in the north field — follow signs from the main gate. Please arrange a designated driver or taxi for the evening, as country lanes are unlit.
travel.train.p1: The nearest station is Moreton-in-Marsh (20 minutes by taxi), with regular trains from London Paddington.
travel.train.p2: Let us know your arrival time on the RSVP form and we'll do our best to help coordinate lifts from the station.
